summary: Implements BIO-BIO-003 (quality-gated face capture), built directly on BIO-BIO-001's provider-neutral biometric contracts and linked to BIO-PHO-001's approved photo master via a narrow gateway. FaceQualityAssessment.FaceCount/FaceCountApproved is a precondition distinct from the seven AC02 checks - exactly one face required before those checks are meaningful (AC01). FaceQualityCheck is a closed seven-member enum (Pose/Eyes/Lighting/Sharpness/Resolution/Occlusion/Background); IFaceQualityChecker/SyntheticFaceQualityChecker assess every capture against all seven (AC02). FaceBiometricReference reuses BIO-BIO-001's own BiometricTemplate.ProviderId/ProviderVersion directly for model/version and carries SourcePhotoMasterVersion+PersonId as source-photo linkage, verified via a narrow IPhotoMasterExistenceGateway before any capture is attempted - deliberately NOT a ProjectReference to BIO-PHO-001, since PhotoMaster is a tenant-scoped internal aggregate (the opposite shape from BIO-BIO-001); the real adapter (Modules/BioBio003Module.cs) wraps BIO-PHO-001's own already-registered PhotoMasterService.GetVersionAsync, the same gateway shape BioPho001Module itself already uses for its own BIO-IDN-001 dependency (AC03). FaceCaptureOutcome is a typed Approve/Reject result, never an exception, for a failed quality/liveness gate; FaceQualityCheckResult.Fail cannot be constructed without actionable guidance (AC04). ILivenessDetector is the only seam the service reaches for a liveness verdict; SyntheticLivenessDetector is the only shipped implementation and participates in the approval gate alongside the seven quality checks - a deliberate design choice (documented in the README) to make liveness a real gate rather than a recorded-but-ignored field (AC05). Repository and service are internal, gated by an explicit InternalsVisibleTo seam (BIO-IDN-001-QA-01/BIO-PHO-001-QA-01 governance shape). Scope boundary: no audit trail added, since none of this story's five ACs require one (documented explicitly in the README, unlike BIO-BIO-002 whose AC05 did require one).
